code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for v in counts if v not in (background, 0)]
    color = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in g for x in row))
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    minr = min(r for r, c in cells)
    minc = min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in cells]
    mh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    mw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h - mh + 1):
        for c in range(w - mw + 1):
            if all(g[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = color
    return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(code)
